title: Use transparent logo and display it properly across the site

requirements.text: Add a cleaned, production-ready transparent-background logo asset for GARUDAYA PRIVATE LIMITED and store it in frontend/public/assets/generated.

quotes: plz use transperens logo and sowe porpurly logo

acceptanceCriteria: A new transparent-background logo image exists under frontend/public/assets/generated.
The new logo is web-friendly (crisp, cropped to remove excessive whitespace, and sized consistently with the current logo usage).

requirements.text: Update the site header and footer to use the transparent-background logo asset instead of /assets/generated/garudaya-logo-white-bg.dim_1200x300.png, and ensure the logo renders clearly (good contrast, not stretched) in both light and dark themes.

quotes: plz use transperens logo and sowe porpurly logo

acceptanceCriteria: frontend/src/components/site/SiteHeader.tsx uses the new transparent logo src path.
frontend/src/components/site/SiteFooter.tsx uses the new transparent logo src path.

Logo preserves aspect ratio (no distortion) and remains clearly visible in header/footer across light and dark theme backgrounds (e.g., via correct sizing and, if needed, a subtle container/background behind the logo).

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui (read-only components).
Do not modify immutable hook/bootstrap files (frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx).
Backend remains single-actor; no backend changes are required for this request.
nonGoals: Implementing new pages, routes, or registration flows beyond the logo update.
Adding or changing authentication, backend logic, or data persistence.
